meaning.en: To talk on and on without stopping, usually to the annoyance of others.
meaning.zh: 说话没完没了，唠叨个不停。

examples.zh: 他在会上喋喋不休地讲了一个小时。
examples.en: He went on and on at the meeting for an hour.

examples.zh: 奶奶又在喋喋不休地数落我了。
examples.en: Grandma was nagging me non-stop again.

examples.zh: 评论员喋喋不休，观众都听烦了。
examples.en: The commentator talked so much that viewers got fed up.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial (喋喋不休地说); mildly derogatory.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，含贬义。

meaning.en: To mutter or chant words under one's breath, originally of someone reciting incantations.
meaning.zh: 原指迷信的人小声念咒语，后泛指小声地自言自语。

examples.zh: 他嘴里念念有词，好像在背单词。
examples.en: He was muttering to himself, as if memorising vocabulary.

examples.zh: 老道士手持桃木剑，口中念念有词。
examples.en: The old Taoist priest held a peachwood sword and chanted under his breath.

usage.en: Predicate; often 嘴里/口中念念有词.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“口中念念有词”。

natural: lose both the person and the money

meaning.en: To lose both a person (through death or departure) and one's money at the same time.
meaning.zh: 人和钱财都失去了。

examples.zh: 他借钱给人做生意，结果对方跑了，落得人财两空。
examples.en: He lent money for a business venture, the man ran off, and he lost both partner and cash.

examples.zh: 钱花光了，病人也没救回来，真是人财两空。
examples.en: The money was all spent and the patient still died — a total loss.

usage.en: Predicate; often 落得/弄得人财两空.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“落得人财两空”。

meaning.en: A matter that affects one's whole life, specifically marriage.
meaning.zh: 关系一辈子的大事，多指婚姻。

equivalents: the big decision of one's life

examples.zh: 父母最关心的是女儿的终身大事。
examples.en: What her parents care about most is their daughter getting married.

examples.zh: 终身大事可不能草率决定。
examples.en: You can't rush a decision about marriage.

examples.zh: 他三十多了，还没解决终身大事。
examples.en: He's over thirty and still hasn't settled down.

usage.en: Subject or object; mostly refers to marriage.
usage.zh: 多作主语、宾语，多指婚姻。

meaning.en: Things become valuable because they are rare.
meaning.zh: 东西因为稀少而显得珍贵。

examples.zh: 物以稀为贵，限量版球鞋价格翻了几倍。
examples.en: Scarcity creates value — limited-edition trainers sell for several times the price.

examples.zh: 这种兰花物以稀为贵，一株要上万元。
examples.en: This orchid is prized for its rarity; one plant costs over ten thousand yuan.

usage.en: Clause; used to explain high prices or high regard.
usage.zh: 多单独成句，解释价格高或受重视的原因。

meaning.en: Exposed to wind and rain; figuratively, subjected to hardship and trials.
meaning.zh: 受风雨的吹打，比喻经受磨难或挫折。

examples.zh: 这座老房子经过多年风吹雨打，已经很破旧了。
examples.en: After years of wind and rain the old house is very run-down.

examples.zh: 经得起风吹雨打的人才能成大事。
examples.en: Only those who can weather hardship achieve great things.

usage.en: Object; often 经过/经不起风吹雨打.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“经不起风吹雨打”。

meaning.en: Different from the usual; out of the ordinary.
meaning.zh: 跟平常的情况很不一样。

examples.zh: 今年夏天异乎寻常地炎热。
examples.en: This summer has been unusually hot.

examples.zh: 他今天表现得异乎寻常地安静。
examples.en: He was unusually quiet today.

usage.en: Adverbial or attributive; formal.
usage.zh: 多作状语、定语，书面语。

pinyin: yáng máo chū zài yáng shēn shàng
literal: wool · comes · at · sheep · body · on
natural: you pay for it in the end

meaning.en: Whatever benefit you seem to get for free is ultimately paid for by you.
meaning.zh: 比喻表面上得到的好处，实际上还是出自自己身上。

equivalents: there's no such thing as a free lunch
you pay for it one way or another

examples.zh: 所谓免费送货，羊毛出在羊身上，运费早就算进价格里了。
examples.en: So-called free delivery — you pay for it anyway; the shipping is built into the price.

examples.zh: 赠品看着划算，其实羊毛出在羊身上。
examples.en: The free gifts look like a bargain, but in the end the customer pays for them.

usage.en: Clause; used to expose hidden costs.
usage.zh: 多单独成句，用来说明隐藏的成本。

meaning.en: Countless words; a great deal one wants to say.
meaning.zh: 形容要说的话很多。

examples.zh: 千言万语，汇成一句话：谢谢你们！
examples.en: All I want to say comes down to one thing: thank you!

examples.zh: 临别时，母亲有千言万语，却只说了句“保重”。
examples.en: At parting, Mother had so much to say but only said 'take care'.

usage.en: Subject or object.
usage.zh: 多作主语、宾语。

meaning.en: To learn from past mistakes so as to avoid them in future.
meaning.zh: 吸取过去失败的教训，以后小心不再犯。

equivalents: so as to prevent a recurrence

examples.zh: 处理这件事要惩前毖后，治病救人。
examples.en: This case should be handled so as to learn from the past and help the person reform.

examples.zh: 通报这起事故，目的是惩前毖后。
examples.en: The accident is being circulated so that lessons are learned.

story.en: The young King Cheng of Zhou resolves to learn from past trouble: 'I will take warning and guard against later ills' (予其惩而毖后患).
story.zh: 《诗经·周颂·小毖》：“予其惩，而毖后患。”

usage.en: Predicate; often paired with 治病救人; official register.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与“治病救人”连用，多用于公文。

meaning.en: Helping the old along and leading the young by the hand; also describes whole families on the move.
meaning.zh: 搀着老人，领着孩子，形容全家老少一起行动，也指照顾老幼。

examples.zh: 村民们扶老携幼，前来观看灯会。
examples.en: Villagers came with young and old alike to see the lantern show.

examples.zh: 尊老爱幼、扶老携幼是中华美德。
examples.en: Caring for the old and the young is a traditional Chinese virtue.

examples.zh: 洪水来临前，居民扶老携幼撤离。
examples.en: Before the flood, residents evacuated with their elderly and children.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语。

natural: a pact to cover for each other

meaning.en: Originally a military alliance; now usually a pact among wrongdoers to protect each other and keep their stories straight.
meaning.zh: 原指国家间的军事同盟，现多指坏人之间互相包庇、订立的口供默契。

equivalents: agree to cover for each other

examples.zh: 几个嫌疑人事先订立了攻守同盟。
examples.en: The suspects had agreed beforehand to cover for one another.

examples.zh: 警方很快就打破了他们的攻守同盟。
examples.en: The police soon broke their pact of silence.

usage.en: Object; often 订立/结成攻守同盟.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“订立攻守同盟”。

meaning.en: A vast expanse of brilliant white snow.
meaning.zh: 形容积雪洁白一片。

examples.zh: 远处的山峰白雪皑皑。
examples.en: The distant peaks are blanketed in snow.

examples.zh: 冬天的哈尔滨白雪皑皑，美不胜收。
examples.en: Harbin in winter is a sea of white snow, breathtakingly beautiful.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; descriptive writing.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，多用于描写。

meaning.en: To stop up one's ears and refuse to listen; to deliberately ignore.
meaning.zh: 塞住耳朵不听，形容故意不听别人的意见。

examples.zh: 大家的劝告，他一概充耳不闻。
examples.en: He turned a deaf ear to everyone's advice.

examples.zh: 对群众的投诉，有关部门不能充耳不闻。
examples.en: The authorities must not ignore the public's complaints.

usage.en: Predicate; often 对……充耳不闻.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“对……充耳不闻”。

meaning.en: A single needle or thread; the smallest, most trivial thing. Also, painstaking stitch-by-stitch work.
meaning.zh: 一根针一根线，比喻极微小的东西；也指一针一针细致地做。

examples.zh: 人民军队不拿群众一针一线。
examples.en: The people's army does not take so much as a needle from the people.

examples.zh: 这件毛衣是妈妈一针一线织出来的。
examples.en: Mum knitted this jumper stitch by stitch.

usage.en: Object or adverbial.
usage.zh: 多作宾语、状语。

meaning.en: The beautiful rivers and mountains of one's country.
meaning.zh: 形容国家壮丽美好的山河。

examples.zh: 退休后，他想走遍祖国的大好河山。
examples.en: After retiring, he wants to travel all over the country's beautiful landscapes.

examples.zh: 先烈们为保卫大好河山献出了生命。
examples.en: The martyrs gave their lives to defend our beautiful land.

usage.en: Object or subject; patriotic, formal tone.
usage.zh: 多作宾语、主语，含热爱祖国之意。

meaning.en: Superior to others by a grade; usually of someone who thinks they are better than everyone else.
meaning.zh: 比别人高出一等，多指自以为比别人优越。

examples.zh: 他总觉得自己高人一等，看不起同事。
examples.en: He always thinks he's better than others and looks down on his colleagues.

examples.zh: 有钱并不意味着高人一等。
examples.en: Being rich doesn't make you superior.

usage.en: Predicate; often 自以为/觉得高人一等.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“自以为高人一等”。

meaning.en: To harbour filth; to shelter bad people and evil practices.
meaning.zh: 比喻包容、隐藏坏人坏事。

examples.zh: 那家夜总会是个藏污纳垢的地方。
examples.en: That nightclub is a den of iniquity.

examples.zh: 清理角落，不让它成为藏污纳垢之处。
examples.en: Clean out the corners so they don't harbour dirt and grime.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; also written 藏垢纳污.
usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语。也作“藏垢纳污”。

meaning.en: Mouth and tongue dry; from talking too much or from thirst.
meaning.zh: 嘴和舌头都干了，形容说话太多或非常口渴。

examples.zh: 我说得口干舌燥，他还是不听。
examples.en: I talked myself hoarse and he still wouldn't listen.

examples.zh: 走了半天山路，大家都口干舌燥。
examples.en: After hours of hiking, everyone was parched.

usage.en: Complement or predicate; often 说得口干舌燥.
usage.zh: 多作补语、谓语，常说“说得口干舌燥”。

pinyin: bù fēn qīng hóng zào bái
literal: not · distinguish · green · red · black · white
natural: without asking who's right or wrong

meaning.en: Without distinguishing right from wrong; indiscriminately.
meaning.zh: 不分是非，不问情由。

examples.zh: 老师不分青红皂白就把两个人都批评了一顿。
examples.en: The teacher told both of them off without finding out who was at fault.

examples.zh: 他不问青红皂白，上来就骂。
examples.en: He started shouting without asking what had happened.

usage.en: Adverbial, often followed by 就; also 不问青红皂白.
usage.zh: 多作状语，后常接“就”。也作“不问青红皂白”。

pinyin: tiān yǒu bù cè fēng yún
variants: 天有不测风云，人有旦夕祸福
literal: sky · has · un- · foreseeable · wind · clouds

meaning.en: Just as the weather can change unexpectedly, misfortune can strike anyone without warning.
meaning.zh: 天气会有预料不到的变化，比喻人随时可能遭遇意外的灾祸。

equivalents: you never know what's round the corner

examples.zh: 天有不测风云，买份保险总没错。
examples.en: You never know what's round the corner — insurance is always a good idea.

examples.zh: 天有不测风云，人有旦夕祸福，谁也想不到他会出事。
examples.en: Fortunes change overnight; no one expected him to have an accident.

usage.en: Clause; often completed with 人有旦夕祸福.
usage.zh: 多单独成句，后常接“人有旦夕祸福”。

natural: have the gift of the gab

meaning.en: Good at talking; articulate and persuasive.
meaning.zh: 形容很会说话。

equivalents: have the gift of the gab

examples.zh: 她能说会道，很适合做销售。
examples.en: She has the gift of the gab — perfect for sales.

examples.zh: 别看他能说会道，做事可不靠谱。
examples.en: He may be a smooth talker, but he's unreliable.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; neutral to mildly ironic.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。

pinyin: wú suǒ bù yòng qí jí
literal: nothing · that · not · use · its · utmost

meaning.en: Originally 'to strive to the utmost in everything'; now 'to use every means, however vile'.
meaning.zh: 原指无处不用尽心力，现指做坏事时什么极端手段都使得出来。

examples.zh: 为了打压对手，他们无所不用其极。
examples.en: They stopped at nothing to crush their rivals.

examples.zh: 诈骗分子无所不用其极，老人尤其要小心。
examples.en: Scammers will try every trick in the book; the elderly must be especially careful.

story.en: The Great Learning says the gentleman 'does his utmost in everything' (是故君子无所不用其极) — a positive sense later reversed.
story.zh: 《礼记·大学》：“是故君子无所不用其极。”

usage.en: Predicate; now derogatory.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，今含贬义。

meaning.en: Unable to fend off or withstand (an attack, pressure, questioning).
meaning.zh: 抵挡不住。

examples.zh: 面对记者连珠炮似的提问，他有点招架不住了。
examples.en: Faced with the reporters' barrage of questions, he was struggling to cope.

examples.zh: 对方攻势太猛，我们的后防招架不住。
examples.en: The opposition attacked so hard our defence couldn't hold out.

examples.zh: 孩子撒起娇来，爷爷就招架不住。
examples.en: When the child turns on the charm, Grandpa can't resist.

usage.en: Predicate; colloquial. Positive form 招架得住.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，口语。肯定说“招架得住”。

meaning.en: Doing something consciously and willingly, without being forced.
meaning.zh: 自己认识到并且心甘情愿地去做。

examples.zh: 参加志愿活动完全是自觉自愿的。
examples.en: Taking part in volunteering is entirely voluntary.

examples.zh: 捐款要自觉自愿，不能强迫。
examples.en: Donations must be voluntary, not forced.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语。
